title: SPA 2027 applications open this fall
body: Applications for the 2026 Sphinx Performance Academy are closed — the 2027 cycle reopens in fall 2026. Full-scholarship summer study for Black and Latinx string players at partner conservatories.

title: Sphinx Virtuosi return to Carnegie Hall
body: The self-conducted string orchestra headlines Carnegie Hall with violinist Amaryn Olmeda, marking America's 250th with new works — including a song cycle by Damien Geter with a libretto by Sphinx founder Aaron P. Dworkin, featuring mezzo-soprano J'Nai Bridges.

title: Andres Sanchez wins the Robert Frederick Smith Prize
body: At the 29th Annual Sphinx Competition finals in Detroit, Andres Sanchez took the Senior Division's top honor. Finalists performed with the Sphinx Symphony Orchestra for a share of more than $100,000 in prizes.

title: 2027 Sphinx Competition applications open
body: The next Sphinx Competition opens for applications in spring 2026 — for Black and Latinx string players in the Junior (up to 17) and Senior (18–35) divisions.

title: Spring tour with Randall Goosby wraps
body: Sphinx Virtuosi toured with violinist Randall Goosby from Feb 19 through Mar 15, 2026, with stops from Emory University to the Colburn School.
